name: Envy Mask
tagline: Jim hunts the mystery client through a super-soldier laboratory guarded by two masked sisters, Neid and Zavist.
summary: Envy Mask is the third chapter of Zombie Scenario: Season 4. Red Lizard Jim pursues the mysterious client behind an illegal super-soldier program through a research complex full of experimental facilities and discovers the client is Dr. Rex, running a government-funded program that turns humans into weapons. The chapter ends against two former human test subjects - Neid, the Dual Sword Wielder, and Zavist, the Heavy Artillery - the first Zombie Scenario map with two main bosses and the first with female bosses.
story: The wiki summarises the story as Red Lizard Jim investigating a mysterious client who is conducting illegal super-soldier experiments. Jim learns that the client is Dr. Rex, who runs a government-funded program converting humans into enhanced weapons. Neid and Zavist were once human subjects transformed into superhuman combatants. Players fight through a research complex filled with experimental facilities - including holograms of captured female characters held in rejuvenation chambers - encounter Frozen Terror as a mini-boss, and finally confront the two sisters. Hypnosis audio elements (chanting, screaming, marching sounds) play in parts of the map. The chapter title refers to the Hannya mask, which represents a jealous female demon or serpent.
objectives: Wiki objective text: pursue the mystery client and investigate the secret super-soldier program; defeat the Dual Sword Wielder Neid and the Heavy Artillery Zavist.
Press E at devices labelled [E] to operate them.
Destroy the red-glowing obstacles to continue the pursuit to the checkpoints.
rewards: Season 4 reward list on the wiki includes the Envy Tattoo (alongside Frozen Terror's club, Snow Crystal Tattoo, Snake Tattoo and Gluttony Tattoo)
trivia: 'Envy Mask' refers to the Hannya mask, which represents a jealous female demon or serpent.
First Zombie Scenario map with two main bosses, and the first with female bosses.
Sections of the map replicate parts of Half-Life (Blast Pit, Surface Tension, Lambda Core).
Inspired by the 2006 Half-Life mod Poke646: Vendetta.
Features holograms of captured female characters in rejuvenation chambers and hypnosis audio (chanting, screaming, marching).
Trailers exist for the Singapore/Malaysia, China, Zombie Scenario Re:boot and Korean releases.
